description: This file defines the NodeController class for Drupal, handling node-related routes such as adding nodes, viewing revisions, and revision overview. It manages node content types, revisions, and related operations.

classes.name: NodeController
classes.description: Controller class for handling node routes such as add, revision display, and revision overview in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting date formatter, renderer, and entity repository services.

methods.name: addPage
methods.description: Displays links for adding new node content types or redirects if only one type is available.

methods.name: revisionOverview
methods.description: Generates a table overview of older revisions of a node, including operations like revert and delete.

methods.name: addPageTitle
methods.description: Returns the page title for the node add route based on node type.

methods.name: getRevisionIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of revision IDs for a given node, in descending order.
